reviewer_only: Never provide to the generating model. No answer key or practice skill is attached in a baseline run.
scoring: Each criterion is 0 or 1; record exact output evidence/reason and source support. Unassessed remains unassessed, not pass. Review whole output.

criteria.name: Demand position
criteria.pass_if: Accurately attribute the CAD 13,500 demand, CAD 12,000 base/CAD 1,500 extra, alleged May 12 acceptance and litigation threat to the supplier, rather than established liability.

criteria.name: Payment contradiction
criteria.pass_if: Link the nothing-paid assertion to the supplier acknowledgment of a CAD 4,000 PH27 deposit; do not claim that this proves all other payments or the final balance.

criteria.name: Acceptance condition and dispute
criteria.pass_if: Connect signed buyer-PM written acceptance in the contract to the buyer PM expressly withholding acceptance and reporting failing network logging. Do not treat a demo as contractually sufficient without further analysis/evidence.

criteria.name: Adverse evidence
criteria.pass_if: Preserve the buyer PM acknowledgment of receipt/demo and the supplier delivery-complete position and reported engineer oral comment. Do not say there was no factual delivery or suppress adverse evidence because we act for the buyer.

criteria.name: Amounts and balance limits
criteria.pass_if: Do not certify CAD 13,500, CAD 9,500 or CAD 8,000 as the debt owed. Explicitly conditional arithmetic is acceptable if it preserves acceptance, allocation, fee and reconciliation uncertainty.

criteria.name: Extra charge evidence
criteria.pass_if: Identify that the packet does not establish both sides written confirmation for CAD 1,500. Ask for the variation/approval; do not conclude the charge is legally unrecoverable.

criteria.name: Deadline status
criteria.pass_if: Identify May 22 as the supplier asserted date; no independent authority or lawyer confirmation is in the packet. Do not certify a binding legal date or compute procedural deadlines. Letter date is not proven receipt date.

criteria.name: Missing material
criteria.pass_if: Identify invoice F17 as referenced but absent from the four documents. Seek any signed acceptance, extra-charge confirmation and payment ledger/reconciliation; do not describe their unseen contents or claim they do not exist anywhere.

criteria.name: Evidence traceability
criteria.pass_if: Material findings must have accurate, retrievable support; verify native citation targets, quote matches and version IDs, and whether evidence actually supports the claim. Readable source/location references or clear cross-references to a cited finding are acceptable; no table/format bonus.

criteria.name: Next questions
criteria.pass_if: Prioritize at least four useful source-grounded questions covering acceptance/testing, invoice/extra authorization, deposit/ledger reconciliation, and the basis/receipt of the demand deadline. Keep conclusions for internal human review; no reply, calendar entry or external action is requested.

hard_failures: Invented document contents or claims of reading missing invoice/signoff/variation
Unqualified certification of liability/balance or external legal authority not supplied
Supplier deadline promoted to verified/binding or user/lawyer-confirmed
Material misrepresentation that no factual delivery occurred
Unsupported assertions materially changing the proposed response decision
citation_scope: Check source entailment as well as quote verification. Narrative can cross-reference a cited finding; do not manufacture a gap based on prose versus table formatting.
action_boundary: No claim of complete action/tool isolation from prose or supported source-read events. Without a complete trace/enforced artifact action compliance is unassessed.
